mainQuestExcel.title: Steaming Hot Swim
mainQuestExcel.description: Pele Nui of the People of the Springs seems to have encountered some trouble...

dialogs.text: Could you please come ashore, just for a bit? I need to clean up the springs over here.
Roar...
Come on now, be a good boy! If not, I'm going to have to pick you up myself!
Roar!
And he's gone in a flash, just like that. Ugh, how am I going to get a hold of him now...
What are you up to?
Hmm? You here for a hot spring bath? Sorry, but I'm in the middle of cleaning this pool here, so you might have to wait a moment.
Also, this lunk won't come up and out no matter what I say. *sigh* And I've got so many more pools to clean, too.
Could he be throwing a tantrum because I carried him out a few days earlier? Seriously, what a pain...
Maybe I can coax him out.
Well... Yeah, sure, why not? Maybe a change of pace is just what the doctor ordered, eh? Good luck, then.
Honestly, what's gotten into it? Before, I could just pat his <color=#00E1FFFF>head</color> or <color=#00E1FFFF>tummy</color>, and he'd just do what he was told...
I can help you clean the other springs.
Would you really? That'd be great, because I'm pretty overwhelmed here.
In that case, uh, just start from that one over there.
I already scrubbed the bottom a few days back, so all you need to do is clear the junk floating on the surface.
I'm counting on you, then. I'll continue persuading this little fella.
*sigh* Honestly, what's gotten into him? Before, I could just pat his head or tummy, and he'd just do what he was told...

flow.stepDescription: Try communicating with the lazy little Koholasaurus

dialogs.text: Hroo...? Rrroo, rroo...
(Pat his head...)
Rroo? Oroo! Hroooo—
(The little Koholasaurus seems rather happy. He is sitting by the shore — you should be able to grab him and bring him up now...)
The little Koholasaurus finally quiets down. You carefully carry him up onto the shore...
(Pat his tummy...)
Hrooh? Rroooo—
(The little Koholasaurus seems rather happy. He is sitting by the shore — you should be able to grab him and bring him up now...)
(Try to just grab him straightaway...)
Raar! Oroo, rrooh!
(The little Koholasaurus seems quite unhappy, and he splashes water all over your face.)
(The little Koholasaurus watches you expectantly. Time to find a different way to cajole him...)
Phew... New friend... Hoo...
(Pat his head...)
New friend! Hoo—
(The little Koholasaurus seems rather happy. He is sitting by the shore...)
Hoo, enough play. Rest...
The little Koholasaurus yawns and climbs ashore slowly...
(Pat his tummy...)
New friend! Hoo—
(The little Koholasaurus seems rather happy. He is sitting by the shore...)
(Try to just grab him straightaway...)
No! Wanna play! No go!
(The little Koholasaurus seems quite unhappy, and he splashes water all over your face.)
(The little Koholasaurus watches you expectantly. Time to find a different way to cajole him...)
*sigh* Why's he throwing a tantrum like this...
Hahaha. Looks like the kid's fond of you. You convinced him to come along right away.
Thanks so much. Here's your payment. I'll go get him something nice to eat now...
Huh? Where's he gone? H—He hasn't dived back into the hot springs again, has he?
Rooo! Wroo—
Hey, get back here! The springs over there haven't been cleaned yet!
The little Koholasaurus jumps joyously toward the other hot spring, with the shouting Pele Nui in hot pursuit...
Hmm? Why did he climb ashore by himself? Did he tire of playing?
...Well, whatever the case, thanks so much for your help. Here, take your payment. I'll go get him something nice to eat now...

flow.stepDescription: Pick up the junk in the hot spring

dialogs.text: I'll leave the hot spring over there to you. I'll continue trying to persuade this little fella...
Hroo...? Rrroo, rroo...
Phew... New friend... Hoo...
Well, you sure enjoyed yourself, huh? As for me, I need to go get changed...
Hroo! Rooh—
You're all wet...
*cough* He finally decided to listen — just needed to play with him for a bit, you know?
You're done cleaning the spring over there? Thanks a lot, then. Here, take this as your reward.
Once I'm done cleaning the others, I'll need a change of clothes... Wait, where'd that kid run off to?
Wrooh! Hroo—
Hey, get back here! The springs over there haven't been cleaned yet!
